meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上后,当你提出天文数据处理或计算需求时,Claude 会用 Astropy 库编写 Python 代码。它能完成单位换算、坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、表格与时间处理、宇宙学计算等,并输出结果或调试建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 Astropy 编写或调试天文数据分析代码时触发,典型任务包括坐标转换、单位换算、FITS 文件读写等。

say.text: 用Astropy把赤道坐标 RA=10.5°, Dec=41.2° 转成银道坐标
用Planck18宇宙学模型计算红移1.5的光度距离
用astropy.io.fits读取这个FITS文件的图像数据和头信息

howto.what_en: After installation, when you request astronomical data work, Claude writes Python code with Astropy for unit conversion, coordinate transformation, FITS I/O, table/time handling, and cosmology, returning results or debugging advice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to write or debug astronomical data analysis code with Astropy, typically coordinate conversion, unit conversion, FITS file handling, etc.

say_en.text: Convert equatorial RA=10.5°, Dec=41.2° to Galactic using Astropy.
Use Planck18 to compute luminosity distance at z=1.5.
Read image data and header from this FITS file with astropy.io.fits.
